facts.text: Replay of raw sensor logs against independent ground truth is the established method for baselining an existing warning system without driving the machine.
facts.quote: Replay of raw sensor logs against an independent ground truth is the established way to baseline the existing warning system without driving the machine.

facts.text: Raw sensor-log replay measures detection, false alarms and warning timing only for the sensors, mounting positions and scenarios actually recorded.
facts.quote: It measures detection, false alarms and warning timing only for the sensors, mounting positions and scenarios that were actually recorded

facts.text: Raw sensor-log replay does not retest anything upstream of the re-injection point, including the lens, imager, antenna, contamination, vibration and glare.
facts.quote: everything upstream of the re-injection point (lens, imager, antenna, contamination, vibration, glare) is not retested.

facts.text: Sensor-log recording must start in October 2026 and continue through the winter.
facts.quote: Recording must start now, in October 2026, including through the winter

facts.text: The validation window of mid-2027 plus four months contains no northern cold season.
facts.quote: the validation window of mid-2027 plus four months contains no northern cold season

facts.text: Ground truth must be independent of the system under test; using the production detector's own output as truth is circular.
facts.quote: Ground truth must be independent of the system under test; using the production detector's own output as truth is circular.

facts.text: The documented ground-truth approach combines surveyed targets, a reference lidar with RTK-GNSS/INS, and audited auto-labels.
facts.quote: A hybrid of surveyed targets, a reference lidar with RTK-GNSS/INS, and audited auto-labels is the documented approach

facts.text: Independent off-road field data on warning-system alarms are old and sparse.
facts.quote: Independent off-road field data are old and sparse

facts.text: The best hard false-alarm figure cited remains a 2006 NIOSH study on a Caterpillar 793B, in which 18% of alarms were false.
facts.quote: the best hard false-alarm figure is still a 2006 NIOSH study on a Caterpillar 793B, where 18% of alarms were false

facts.text: In the 2006 NIOSH study on a Caterpillar 793B, 42% of alarms were nuisance alarms.
facts.quote: a 2006 NIOSH study on a Caterpillar 793B, where 18% of alarms were false and 42% were nuisance alarms

facts.text: In the 2006 NIOSH study on a Caterpillar 793B, the audible alarm was found switched off after shifts.
facts.quote: and the audible alarm was found switched off after shifts

facts.text: Fair comparison of old and new systems requires comparison at the system-output level in world or risk coordinates, ideally recorded in parallel on the same machine.
facts.quote: Old and new systems can be compared fairly only at the system-output level, in world or risk coordinates, ideally recorded in parallel on the same machine

facts.text: Fair system-output comparison uses warnings and interventions per hazard, missed hazards, false and nuisance alarms per hour, and warning time-to-collision against common ground truth and a common hazard zone, such as the ISO 21815-3 risk area.
facts.quote: warnings and interventions per hazard, missed hazards, false and nuisance alarms per hour, and warning time-to-collision against a common ground truth and a common hazard zone such as the ISO 21815-3 risk area.

facts.text: Raw detections and per-sensor statistics cannot be compared fairly when sensor modality, mounting or processing changes.
facts.quote: Raw detections and per-sensor statistics are not comparable when modality, mounting or processing changes

facts.text: Automatic braking invalidates open-loop replay at the first brake command absent from the old run; after that command, the recorded future no longer represents the future the machine would have experienced.
facts.quote: Automatic braking breaks open-loop replay at a definable point: the first brake command the old run did not contain. After it, the recorded future is no longer the future the machine would have experienced.

facts.text: Perception and brake-trigger timing are tested open-loop on recorded logs.
facts.quote: Perception and trigger timing are tested open-loop on logs

facts.text: Braking consequences are tested using closed-loop simulation, hardware-in-the-loop and proving-ground tests.
facts.quote: braking consequences are tested in closed-loop simulation, hardware-in-the-loop and on a proving ground

facts.text: Matching the old warning system is the wrong target for an automatic-braking system.
facts.quote: "Match the old system" is the wrong target.

facts.text: Adding a brake command brings a system within the scope of ISO 19014-2.
facts.quote: Adding a brake command moves the system into the scope of ISO 19014-2

facts.text: ISO 19014-2 excludes awareness systems that do not affect machine motion.
facts.quote: ISO 19014-2, which excludes awareness systems that do not affect machine motion.

facts.text: Automatic braking is a new safety-control function with its own hazards.
facts.quote: Automatic braking is a new safety-control function with its own hazards

facts.text: Unnecessary braking is the dominant documented automatic-braking failure mode on the road, based on NHTSA investigations covering millions of vehicles.
facts.quote: unnecessary braking is the dominant documented failure mode on the road (NHTSA investigations covering millions of vehicles)

facts.text: Nuisance interventions are the main documented reason deployed proximity systems were disabled in mining.
facts.quote: nuisance interventions are the main documented reason deployed proximity systems were disabled in mining

facts.text: A rapid stop can destabilize a machine on a slope, with a suspended load or while loading a trailer.
facts.quote: a rapid stop can destabilize a machine on a slope, with a suspended load or while loading a trailer

facts.text: Automatic-braking safety analysis must separately analyze failure to intervene when needed and intervention when unsafe or unnecessary.
